menuNote: DeLand, Florida: Skydive DeLand on DeLand Municipal Airport (KDED)

aerodrome.name: DeLand Municipal Airport - Sidney H. Taylor Field

origin.what: centroid of the main landing area (the grass between the Skydive DeLand facility, taxiway D and the tree line, NE of the DZ)

runways.evidence: OSM way 26414286 (05-23, asphalt, 1311 m x 23 m); FAA: 4301 x 75 ft. Ends agree with the NAIP photo within a few metres.
OSM way 26414292 (12-30, asphalt, 1829 m x 30 m); FAA: 6001 x 100 ft. The RWY 30 end falls on the end of the pavement in the NAIP photo.

paved.name: Apron in front of the DZ (loading area)
paved.evidence: Digitized on the NAIP photo (USGS ImageServer, 0.3 m): dark asphalt NE of the T-hangars where the jump planes load.

paved.name: Taxiway D along the landing area (west part)
paved.evidence: OSM taxiway D (way 462213751) centreline buffered to 12 m, the width measured on the NAIP photo.

paved.name: Taxiway D along the landing area (curve)
paved.evidence: OSM taxiway D (way 462213751) centreline buffered to 12 m.

paved.name: Skydive DeLand car park
paved.evidence: Digitized on the NAIP photo: parking lot E of the facility, along Skydive Drive.

landingAreas.name: Main landing area (grass NE of the facility, pea gravel pit)
landingAreas.evidence: NAIP photo: open mown grass between the facility, the dark apron, taxiway D and the ditch and tree line to the SE, with a pea gravel pit in it; parachute traffic lands here (DeLand airport's own pilot briefing: 'chutes landing on the left side [of RWY 05] and the area near Skydive DeLand').

target.evidence: NAIP photo: a light pit about 17 x 14 m, colour sampled.

buildings.name: Skydive DeLand facility (manifest, packing, briefing, shops)
buildings.evidence: OSM way 1065382013 (Microsoft footprint) at the OSM 'Skydive Deland' node; light low-slope roofs on the NAIP photo. Height and walls guessed.

buildings.name: Dark-roofed building by the landing area
buildings.evidence: OSM way 1065382014; use and height guessed.

pattern.description: NOT PUBLISHED - inferred. Finals along the long axis of the landing area (~107/287 deg), into the wind. The pattern is flown on its north side, over the airfield grass and runway 12/30, away from the T-hangars and the industrial park to the south: left-hand with the usual easterly, right-hand with a westerly.
pattern.landingDirection: Into the wind. The aircraft pattern at KDED is left-hand on all runways; the jump aircraft avoid overflying the airport during parachute operations (AFD remark).
pattern.holdingArea: Upwind of the landing area over the airfield grass.

jumpRun.aircraft: DHC-6 Twin Otters (N24HV registered to Vertical Air, operating as Skydive DeLand)
jumpRun.description: 13,500 ft, the usual US full altitude; along the wind over the airport.

wind.station: KDED DeLand Municipal ASOS (on the field)
wind.period: 2015-01-01 to 2024-12-31, 09:00-18:00 local, all months (IEM ASOS archive)
wind.notes: No strongly dominant direction: E 11%, ENE 9%, N 8%, S 7%, W 7%, calm 6.5%; easterlies (the Atlantic sea breeze) lead from spring to autumn, northerlies in winter. Median 15 km/h (p25 11, p75 18.5).

invented: Canopy pattern side and legs: nothing published; inferred from the layout and the wind.
Landing area outline: the grass seen on the photo; the DZ's own limits are not published.
Building heights and wall colours; the DZ windsock's place (an orange marker on the grass on the photo).
Exit height 4100 m (13,500 ft, the usual figure; not stated on the DZ's site), and the plane drawn is the sim's PC-6, not a Twin Otter.
